name: isa-ask
description: ISA close: is one explicit ask of the user honestly answered by its line and the evidence?

met.instructions: Is this ask met as the line says, according to the evidence? When the line says met, answer high only if the evidence shows the ask done as asked. When the line says skipped or surfaced, answer high only if the line gives a real reason. Answer low when the line claims more than the evidence shows.
